item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.33)] Synopsys and Amazon Sign Multi-Year Silicon IP Agreement Valued at More Than $1 Billion
item.description:

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.33)] Synopsys Expands Silicon IP Business With Amazon As Lead Customer — Multi-Year Deal Targets Custom Chips, AI Infrastructure
item.description:

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.31)] Microsoft To Enable Usage-Based Billing By Default For Copilot Business Licenses
item.description:

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.24)] Reinvesting T. Rowe Price's Dividend for 20 Years Changes the Math Completely. Here's How.
item.description:

Rowe Price (NASDAQ: TROW) has a strong history of dividend growth, having increased its dividend for 40 consecutive years, and currently offers a nearly 5% dividend yield with a comfortable payout ratio. item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.12)] Gartner: AI is changing cybersecurity faster than cloud ever did
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.12)
According to Gartner analyst Josh Murphy, AI is rapidly transforming the cybersecurity landscape, with 94% of executives seeing it as the main driver of cyber transformation. However, AI also introduces new risks, particularly internal ones like shadow AI and data leakage, which 87% of executives identify as the fastest-growing cyber risk. Murphy advises organizations to prioritize immediate actions ("sprints") rather than multi-year programs, focusing on controlling AI access and ensuring visibility, rather than cutting essential security controls for AI projects.

item.description:
